FN-FMLBCD5-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 254
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/01/2024
House Bill 254 as introduced would exempt the principal residence of any veteran, who is at least
20% disabled, from a portion of the ad valorem tax of the property, equal to the disability rating of
the veteran, which would reduce ad valorem tax receipts to the following funds/entities, annually, by
the estimated amounts shown below, beginning in Fiscal Year 2026, assuming the average
cumulative millage rate of 42.65 mills and an average home price of $220,000.
State County Schools Municipal Total
Ad Public School Fund: $247,000
Valorem State General Fund: $206,000
Tax Veterans' Assistance Fund: $82,000 $1.12 M $1.14 M $716 k $3.5 M
Decrease
Alabama Historical Commission: $1,000
Total: $536,000
